title: Lower CICS, SQL, DLI, and MQ operands through a storage-aware host ABI
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of host_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: CICS literals are quote-normalized while FROM, COMMAREA, RIDFLD, LENGTH, queue/map, and transaction variables dereference storage before provider dispatch.
INTO, RESP, and RESP2 remain typed destinations; exact CICS response fields and mainframe-env.cics.into@1 payloads mutate only declared views.
SQL and DLI publish through a versioned MEHOST01/mainframe-env.embedded-host@1 envelope containing family, opcode, named direction, and bounded values rather than a raw command string.
SQL SELECT/FETCH host variables distinguish write destinations before FROM from read inputs after FROM; DLI PCB/SSA operands are named read-write views.
MQ calls use the program identity as opcode and mainframe-env.cobol.call@1 carries ordered parameter names, by-reference mode markers, and storage bytes.
The exact corpus scan covers 240 CICS, 20 SQL, 26 DLI, and 22 MQ operations, 673 typed operand markers, 232 destinations, every reached opcode, and four executable ABI oracles.
